email.headline: An answer-bot that keeps an account of itself
email.body:
P95 latency, token usage per model, daily spend trends — tracked automatically, no extra configuration.

That is what a question asked in Slack can look like on the way back.

The same handbook questions come back to the channel every week, and the answer sits somewhere in a few hundred pages nobody finds by guessing titles.

A responder wired from Slack events, a vector store and a model API will answer them. What it will not tell you is what a week of questions cost, or what that number does when the whole company starts asking.

orqAgent is a no-code platform for building AI agents. Slack is a native channel — OAuth install, the bot replies to mentions and channel messages.

Every message it handles is a **real agent run**: it consumes credits and appears in Analytics exactly like an API call. The accounting is part of the product, not something you add after.

> **Start for free, no card** — one policy, one channel, and a record of what each answer cost.

One policy, one channel. Read the first day's numbers yourself.
email.postscript: The free plan needs no card.
